summary: Exact candidate 8e565f0acdfded2ad7aa918e9cd072f909f12cb8 fixes direct global, direct object/module-attribute, and direct closure-cell helper rebinding, including the current compile_pa_decode_tile cdiv case. It does not fully satisfy the dependency-invalidation contract: dependencies behind an attribute target are not traversed, and dependency references are frozen at decoration time, so replacement helpers can introduce untracked dependencies. Both independent cases reused a stale wrapper and old compiled value.

tests.what_was_measured: Prepared-base reproduction on the actual compile_pa_decode_tile factory: the same signature returned the identical wrapper after cdiv rebinding; the sentinel appeared only after manual cache_clear().
Exact-candidate submitted regression plus existing JIT cache-key tests: 19 passed.
Exact candidate invalidated the current PA compile factory and observed the rebound cdiv sentinel on the first repeated-signature call without manual clearing.

Expected review failure: direct attribute rebinding invalidated, but an attributed helper's changed closure cell and a replacement helper's newly introduced dependency both returned the identical stale wrapper and old compiled value.
Exact-candidate full unit suite: 1102 passed, 17 skipped.
No PA tests collected; module skipped because aiter requires Triton >=3.6.0 while the prepared environment has 3.5.1+rocm7.2.0.gita272dfa8.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950-class, torch reports capability 9.5) was visible, but this independent review did not claim a numerical kernel run because the repository PA module could not collect with the pinned aiter/Triton combination. The original stale-wrapper mechanism and candidate behavior were exercised on the actual PA compile factory before launch.

remaining_counterexamples: A compile factory calls container.fn(), where fn is unchanged but a closure cell captured by fn is rebound. Attribute-path snapshotting sees the same callable identity/code and dependency discovery never traverses the attribute target, so the old wrapper is reused.

A directly referenced helper is rebound to a replacement helper with a new global/closure dependency. The helper rebinding invalidates once, but dependency references were frozen when the decorator was created; later changes to the replacement helper's dependency reuse the stale wrapper.
remaining_limitations: Candidate changes are Python-only; no C++/LLVM files changed, so the prepared native rebuild was not applicable. Python imports were verified from /job/repo/python/flydsl and native flydsl._mlir remained /opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/flydsl/_mlir. The assigned MI350X is supported by the direct tile path, but independent GPU numerical execution remains unverified in this review because tests/kernels/test_pa.py is gated by an incompatible pinned aiter/Triton pair. Raw logs and standalone reproducers are retained outside the checkout at /job/review-evidence-j-902695a78ac9.
